text: Footy fans, September means one thing, finals footy, and Queensland has got skin in the game. The Broncos and the Cowboys are both sharpening up for their finals campaigns and the mood around the grounds this week has been electric.

speaker: alice
text: There is nothing quite like September footy in this state, the barbecues are firing, the jerseys are out and everyone has got an opinion on who is peaking at the right time. Good luck to both sides, we will be cheering from the couch.

speaker: charlie
text: Fingers crossed for a big Queensland showing this finals series, it would be a ripper way to cap off the season.
